gifts.explain_sent: From that come a few rough directions – interests like “Coffee & tea” and a taste like “sporty” or “Scandinavian”, also from well-known brands. Only these words and your budget go to our server – no names, no wishes, no brands, no links.

gifts.explain_no_profile: No profile is stored – only what you tapped yourself in Pompon’s wish box stays on this device. Tap an interest to remove it, or switch personalisation off altogether.
gifts.explain_demo: Right now every product and shop is invented (demo). Real shops come later – partner links would then be marked “Ad”.
gifts.explain_real: Real products from real shops, picked by us. Prices are approximate, see the date on each offer. The shops pay us nothing.
